I'm gonna put this link to this in the description we're gonna go through the process of linking that you need to create a twitch account And you're gonna link that to your Amazon Prime account Amazon owns Twitch so it's all essentially one big company, but that's how you're gonna connect the two Now what that does is it allows you to give away a free subscription on Twitch if you go to twitch.tv I'm gonna pull up just a random person here. So let's go to browse Hearthstone And we'll pop in here The link to my twitch channel will be in the description and on the screen You can see over here on the right hand. Side is subscribe after I've logged into twitch and I've I've Linked to my Amazon Prime account to my twitch account you click on subscribe You can either subscribe now for $5 a month, or you can use your free channel sub with Twitch prime, which is subscribe for free. You're gonna click that button. That helps support. My channel, it helps me make more content and better content and future content coming up to go to my channel you want to go to www.twitch.tv slash btwkeq.com , like i said, i will put that link down in the description below on this side you'll see the same subscription button .Click on free subscription if you have linked your twitch and amazon prime accounts click that you're helping to support my channel you're going away a free sub which is not costing you anything because you're already paying for Amazon Prime And it's greatly appreciated by me and the people that work with me in the quote-o making videos for my YouTube and my Twitch stream So hopefully this helps you if you have any questions leave a comment down the comment section below and like always guys. good luck and have fun

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is to explain how viewers can support a gaming and streaming channel using a free Twitch subscription available through Amazon Prime. The account-linking instructions and visible Twitch menu present an ordinary platform feature and channel-support action rather than an observable investment, credential-harvesting, or deceptive payment scheme. The action is framed as using an existing Prime benefit rather than requiring an additional payment.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary platform reward and promotional support action: viewers with Amazon Prime are instructed to use an available free Twitch channel subscription to support the creator.

evidence.observation: The title promotes supporting a channel by using a free Twitch subscription available to viewers with Amazon Prime.
evidence.quote: Help support the channel by using your FREE Twitch.tv sub if you have Amazon Prime!

evidence.observation: The speaker describes a free Twitch subscription available through Amazon Prime.
evidence.quote: you can giveaway a free Twitch subscription which you have access to if you have Amazon Prime

evidence.observation: The source distinguishes a paid subscription option from the free Twitch Prime channel-subscription option.
evidence.quote: You can either subscribe now for $5 a month, or you can use your free channel sub with Twitch prime, which is subscribe for free.

evidence.observation: The speaker states that the free subscription does not require an additional payment because it is available through an existing Amazon Prime subscription.
evidence.quote: you're going away a free sub which is not costing you anything because you're already paying for Amazon Prime

evidence.observation: The supplied frame visibly shows a Twitch panel labeled 'Free Channel Sub with Twitch Prime' with a 'Subscribe Free' control and a separate paid-subscription section.
The instruction includes linking an account to an Amazon Prime account to access the described subscription benefit.
